rationale: Fixed 30 ms minimized aggregate stall excess. Fixed 75 ms remained inside the latency and longest-stall gates but regressed aggregate stall excess by 3.64%. Every RTT-aware candidate regressed aggregate stall excess; the mildest RTT candidate regressed by 1.25% and exceeded the 2 ms matched-frame p50 gate. Ages above 30 ms did send useful RTX at high RTT, including 2,554 delivered RTX packets for fixed 500 ms across the 300/500 ms RTT cases, but that recovery increased rather than reduced aggregate stalls.
